full_judgment: 7. Mr Mir Hashmat Ali, the learned Assistant Attorney-General appearing for the petitioner, submits that the only question to be decided in this case is whether the case before the Court of Settlement was barred by limitation and he submits that the Court of Settlement acted without lawful authority in allowing the petition of the respondents without considering the question of limitation in accordance with law. He further submits that as soon as a property is listed as abandoned property in the schedule there is a presumption of law that it is an abandoned property and the case having not been filed within time before the Court of Settlement, their claim is barred by limitation.
